descriptionHtml:
Gigabyte B860 AORUS ELITE Motherboard Specifications

​The Gigabyte B860 AORUS ELITE is a premium mainstream motherboard designed for enthusiasts who require high-end power delivery, advanced cooling, and next-gen connectivity. Positioned above the Eagle series, the AORUS ELITE focuses on superior aesthetics and enhanced durability for stable gaming and overclocking performance.

​Core Specifications

  • ​Socket: Intel® Socket LGA 1851 / 1700 (Depending on CPU generation)
  • ​Chipset: Intel® B860
  • ​Form Factor: ATX
  • ​CPU Support: Supports Intel® Core™ Ultra processors and 14th/13th/12th Gen Intel® Core™ processors.

​Memory Support

  • ​Slots: 4 x DDR5 DIMM
  • ​Max Capacity: 192GB
  • ​Speeds: Supports 8000+(OC) MHz
  • ​Features: XMP 3.0 Support and Dual Channel architecture with shielded memory routing.

​Expansion & Storage

  • ​PCIe Slots:
    • ​1 x PCIe 5.0 x16 (UD Slot - Reinforced for heavy GPUs)
    • ​2 x PCIe 4.0 x16 (running at x4 or x1 mode)
  • ​M.2 Slots: * 3 x M.2 PCIe 4.0 x4 slots
    • ​All slots equipped with M.2 Thermal Guards
  • ​SATA Ports: 4 x SATA 6Gb/s

​Connectivity & Audio

  • ​Ethernet: 1 x 2.5GbE LAN port (High-speed gaming networking)
  • ​Rear I/O Ports:
    • ​1 x USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 (Type-C) - 20Gbps
    • ​2 x USB 3.2 Gen 2 (Type-A)
    • ​4 x USB 3.2 Gen 1
    • ​1 x HDMI 2.1 / 1 x DisplayPort 1.4
    • ​Optical S/PDIF Out + Audio Jacks
  • ​Audio: Realtek® ALC1220 or High-Definition Audio with Audiophile-grade capacitors.

​Power & Thermal Design

  • ​VRM: 12+1+1 Twin Digital VRM Design with 60A DrMOS for stable CPU power.
  • ​Heatsinks: Fully Covered MOSFET Heatsinks with high-conductivity thermal pads.
  • ​Smart Fan 6: Multiple PWM/DC fan headers and internal temperature sensors.

​Key Highlights

  • ​Ultra Durable™ Design: Features PCIe UD Slot for 10x load-bearing capacity and a 2oz Copper PCB for better heat dissipation.
  • ​EZ-Latch: Quick-release mechanism for M.2 SSDs and PCIe slots, making hardware upgrades tool-less and easy.
  • ​Hi-Fi Audio: Features a dedicated audio noise guard to prevent interference from other components.
  • ​RGB Fusion: Onboard addressable LED headers for full system lighting synchronization via Gigabyte Control Center.
